literal_meaning: বিষাক্ত দৃষ্টিতে পড়া (poisonous glance under which one falls)
figurative_meaning_en: To become the object of displeasure or wrath
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বসের বিষনজরে পড়েছে, এখন কাজে সমস্যা হচ্ছে।
নতুন প্রমোশনের পর তার সাথীরা তাকে বিষনজরে দেখছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has fallen under his boss's evil eye, and now he's facing problems at work.
After the new promotion, his colleagues are looking at him with displeasure.
note: This idiom draws from the widespread cultural belief in the 'evil eye' (nazar) in Bengali society, often linked to envy or malice.
